description: xFarm Technologies is a tech company focused on the digitalization of the agri-food sector, providing innovative tools that can support farmers and stakeholders in the management of their businesses and the reduction of their footprint.
tagline: Digital Farming Ecosystem for Farmers & Agrifood Supply

description: Yampa is reinventing customer service standards with its autonomous AI agents, available 24/7 to naturally converse with clients and instantly resolve their requests, even the most complex ones. tagline: Autonomous AI Agents for a New Era of Customer Care

description: Yoco is a payments company that builds tools and services to help small businesses in Africa get paid, run their business better, and grow. They started in South Africa.
tagline: Payment aggregator offering payments solution

description: The e-commerce web builder, Zaapi, is helping to shape the future of ecommerce in Southeast Asia, building a digital commerce infrastructure for MSMEs. tagline: Building a digital commerce infrastructure for MSMEs

description: Zeel is an in-home health, wellness, and medical testing platform, offering mobile COVID-19 PCR testing and vaccination, massage therapy, physical therapy, cognitive behavioral therapy, and skilled nursing care.

description: Founded in 2018, the Singaporean startup Zenyum provides 3D-printed Invisible Braces, produced under the highest quality standards, to the rising Asian middle class.

description: The Greentech startup Zolar was founded in Berlin in 2016 by Alex Melzer and Gregor Loukidis.
